chunks: From him, from Muḥammad ibn Sinān, from Ibn Muskān, from Abī Baṣīr, who said:
I asked Abā Jaʿfar عليه السلام about a man who forgot to perform the bowing. He said: repeating the prayer is upon him.

key_terms.أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ: Imam Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام, the authority being asked
key_terms.الْإِعَادَةُ: repetition of the prayer due to invalidity
key_terms.رَجُلٍ: a man, meaning the person under discussion
key_terms.يَرْكَعَ: to perform ruku', the bowing in salat

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if someone forgets the ruku' in salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning one who forgets the ruku' in salat (prayer). Imam Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام states that such a person must repeat the prayer, showing the essential nature of ruku' in the validity of salat.
